Class Internship

java.lang.Object
Internship
public class Internship extends Object
Represents an internship opportunity in the system. Contains details about the internship, applicant tracking, and status management.

    • Internship

      public Internship(String internshipID, String title, String description, String level, String preferredMajor, String companyRepresentative, Date openingDate, Date closingDate, String companyName, int totalSlots)
      Constructs a new Internship with the specified parameters.
      Parameters:
      internshipID - The unique identifier for the internship
      title - The title of the internship
      description - The description of the internship
      level - The difficulty level (Basic, Intermediate, Advanced)
      preferredMajor - The preferred major for applicants
      companyRepresentative - The company representative managing this internship
      openingDate - The date when the internship opens for applications
      closingDate - The date when the internship closes for applications
      companyName - The name of the company offering the internship
      totalSlots - The total number of available slots
